_comment: BioUML MCP endpoint. Auth is the standard BioUML login (NO 'system' shortcut): the session must be alive and carry a logged-in user. To obtain a session: POST https://biouml2test.biouml.org/biouml/web/login with form fields username=<MCP_USER> and password=<MCP_PASS> (the dedicated MCP credential lives in the gitignored .env file at the repo root, keys MCP_USER / MCP_PASS). The response sets a JSESSIONID cookie; carry it (or pass it as ?sessionId=<value>) on every /mcp request. Example: source .env; curl -c /tmp/c.txt -X POST https://biouml2test.biouml.org/biouml/web/login --data-urlencode "username=$MCP_USER" --data-urlencode "password=$MCP_PASS"; then curl -b /tmp/c.txt -X POST 'https://biouml2test.biouml.org/bioumlweb/mcp' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/list","params":{}}'.
